details: No contiguous series exists, and the gaps sit before the peak. Actelion reported Opsumit per product from launch but only in part: 2013Q4 CHF 5m, 2014Q3 CHF 59m, 2014Q4 CHF 68m, 2015Q3 CHF 147m, 2016Q1 CHF 178m and 2016Q3 CHF 218m are stated outright, while 2015Q1, 2015Q2, 2015Q4 and 2016Q4 are not separately citable and 2015H1 (CHF 207m) is one equation in two unknowns. J&J owns the product only from the 16 June 2017 Actelion acquisition, so 2018 is its first full reported year and no annual figure is citable for 2015-2017. From 2025 J&J merges it into a combined OPSUMIT/OPSYNVI line, and allocating that would invent values. FY2013-FY2014 in CHF and FY2018-FY2024 in USD are carried as partial_context; with the pre-peak middle missing, 2024 is a highest-observed value on a rising curve, not a lifetime peak.
Early standalone quarters are missing and J&J aggregates Veletri after the acquisition.
source_quote: Sales by product FY2016: Veletri CHF 97 million; Q4 2016 CHF 26 million.
